game.name: GoldenEye 007
game.desc: Native ARM64/GLES GoldenEye 007 port with ARM-GE Glass Control Deck. Launches directly from EmulationStation after install; supply your own US NTSC ROM.

game.name: GoldenEye Benchmark
game.desc: Automated in-engine GoldenEye benchmark suite. Runs representative missions, records FPS, frame pacing, CPU and RAM telemetry, saves reports, then returns to EmulationStation.
